title: Rey Mysterio challenges the cruiserweight gatekeeper
summary: Rey Mysterio arrives with a style that contrasts sharply with Dean Malenko’s controlled technique. Their early championship matches establish both the newcomer and the division’s appeal.

chapters.title: Malenko wins Rey’s WCW debut
chapters.result: Malenko defeats Mysterio to retain the Cruiserweight title.
chapters.context: The newcomer loses, but his aerial offense immediately distinguishes him within WCW.

chapters.title: Rey wins the Nitro rematch
chapters.result: Mysterio defeats Malenko for the Cruiserweight championship.
chapters.context: Within weeks of his debut, Rey solves the champion and wins his first WCW title.
